description.short: Reusable QNN inference executors (single/multi-process, async, shared-memory) for running models on the Snapdragon NPU, with a runnable demo.
description.long: Edge Inferencer wraps QAI AppBuilder's QNNContext / QNNContextProc / QNNShareMemory into a small library of drop-in inference executors: QnnExecutor (single-process synchronous), QnnTaskExecutor (cross-process via shared memory), QnnProcessPool / QnnExecutor3 (multi-process pool built on Pipe + Manager + SharedMemory), and QnnTaskPool (async InferenceAsync/InferenceWait). It handles ARM performance-core affinity, NHWC/NCHW input normalization, and zero-copy shared-memory I/O so you can pipeline frames across processes on the HTP. The included main.py demo downloads a small public QNN DLC on first run, loads it with QnnExecutor, and runs one inference; it degrades gracefully on machines without an NPU.
